name: Curse of Death's Kiss
source:
In the harsh world of Victorian high society, it pays to have a good name and a handsome butler by your side. But things aren’t as they seem… For you are cursed.

Anything you touch instantly dies, and for that reason, you are bound by the walls of your estate. After a run-in with a rather flirtatious thief, you realize there may be a way to break the curse. Will you succeed and be able to live with the man of your dreams, or will you be doomed to a life of cold solitude?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.midas&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dmidas_web]Google Play[/url]]
translation:
在维多利亚时代上流社会的严酷世界中，有一个好名声和一个英俊的管家在你身边是值得的。但事情并不像看上去的那样……因为你被诅咒了。

你接触到的任何东西都会立即死亡，因此，你被庄园的围墙所束缚。在与一个相当轻浮的小偷发生冲突后，你意识到可能有一种方法可以打破诅咒。你会成功并能够与你梦想中的男人生活在一起，还是注定要过寒冷孤独的生活？

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genius.midas&referrer=utm_source%3Dwebpage%26utm_campaign%3Dmidas_web]Google Play[/url]]
